text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
H-hold up... I appreciate the thought,<n>but there's no
need to bend over<n>backwards over it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm not used to having the<n>dazzling main
character come in and<n>try to lift me up...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You sure? There are a lot of people<n>who wanna
celebrate your birthday<n>with you, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, even I've noticed your<n>impressive track
record. You always<n>place well in every race you
enter.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
'Course I did. Just between you and<n>me, I think
there's a good chance<n>your future's gonna be
bright.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? Maybe you'll be the<n>most popular
Umamusume around<n>real soon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The most popular Umamusume...<n>C'mon, no need
for jokes like that.<n>Even if that were possible, it'd
probably take forever.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with taking<n>your time. So
hey, lemme hear it!<n>Shout out loud that one day,
you'll<n>surpass me in popularity.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, fine... I'll beat you one day, Teio!<n>I-in three
years!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, make that thirty years! I've<n>only got a slim
chance, but I'll keep at<n>it!
